reply.subject: Rent increase – information and documents needed

clauses.text: We understand that you contest the increase from CHF 2,050 to CHF 2,290 per month, effective 1 April, and report that it is based on the mortgage reference interest rate and stairwell renovation/new lift. You say the old lift repeatedly broke down and ask whether costs were counted twice.
Your message does not specify the year of the effective date or when you received the notice. We cannot yet determine the objection deadline or assess the calculation and merits.
Please send the rent-increase notice and proof showing when you received it, together with your lease contract, current-rent evidence, and any prior rent adjustment notice or calculation.

Please also send the notice’s stated reasons and calculation, the reference-rate basis (old and proposed rate bases and relevant dates), and the renovation-cost breakdown showing the works, costs, and rent allocation.
If available, please send correspondence with the landlord about the increase. Old-lift inspection, repair, or maintenance records could also help clarify your concern about the lift replacement.
